name: AI
description: Tools that use a language model through an ai-server: a whole scenario from a sentence (a madness map, an RPG, a tower defense — designed, then built step by step from a toolkit of trigger systems), a map laid out from a prompt, an area redone, triggers written and explained, names, briefings, a review of the map, string rewrites, and an assistant docked beside the map that reads and edits everything in it with you.
author: Jeany
